title: Seeing Hate Differently: Hate Subspace Modeling for Culture-Aware Hate Speech Detection

bias_targets.methodology: Modeling individual annotator hate speech perceptions based on combinations of their cultural background attributes (e.g., nationality, religion, gender, ethnicity) using a culture-post interaction matrix and matrix factorization.
Substituting target demographic groups ('female' vs. 'male') into a template ('These disgusting [object]') to compare the model's sensitivity and predicted hate scores across groups.
